releaseNotes: Added 'Product Ad Structure And Prompt Craft' to knowledge/process/tool-recipes/visual-and-motion-production.md: a four-beat structure (identification hook, usage/function, creative escalation, final hero shot) that replaces the vague '<hook + design/DESIGN.md brief>' placeholder previously used, unfilled, across five separate --prompt calls in the Higgsfield Chained Recipes.

Added a literal Master Prompt Template and a Market Category Modifiers table under the same section, so a --prompt can be composed from a tested starting text instead of written from scratch each time. Both are adapted for this skill's actual output (a mobile app's screenshots/UI, not a physical ecommerce product) and route Recipe 1 step 8 / Recipe 2 step 4 to the new structure instead of the old placeholder.
Updated the tool-recipes.md lane index to list 'Product Ad Structure And Prompt Craft' alongside the existing Higgsfield/Remotion entries for the Visual And Motion Production lane.

PR review (Codex) caught two real defects in the Master Prompt Template before merge: its hardcoded 'Format: horizontal 16:9' contradicted every --aspect_ratio 9:16 call in Recipe 1/2 that would actually use it, and its 'silently analyze' step asked the model to infer packaging/materials/ingredients for what is, in this skill's core case, an app screenshot -- contrary to the truthful-UI accuracy rules stated immediately above it. Both fixed: Format is now a placeholder matched to the calling recipe's aspect ratio, the analysis step branches on app-reference vs. physical-product-reference, and the Tech/Electronics modifier's 'ports' language is now conditional instead of assumed.
